  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  JULY 29, 2025

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Negrete at 5:35 p.m., on
  Tuesday, July 29, 2025, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA.

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Lana Negrete
  Mayor Pro Tem Caroline Torosis
  Councilmember Jesse Zwick
  Councilmember Dan Hall
  Councilmember Ellis Raskin
  Councilmember Barry Snell
  Councilmember Natalya Zernitskaya

  Also Present:  City Manager Oliver Chi
  City Attorney Douglas Sloan
  City Clerk Nikima S. Newsome

  CONVENE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 5:35 p.m., with all
  members present.

  STATEMENT OF  The City of Santa Monica is located on the land of Tovangaar. With
  ACCOUNTABILITY  great respect, the City acknowledges the Gabrieleño/Tongva as the First
  (LAND  People of this ancestral and unceded territory of Kuruvungna, a village
  ACKNOWLEDGEMENT)  that we know as Santa Monica. We honor their elders, past and present,
  and the Gabrieleño descendants who are part of the Gabrieleño /Tongva
  tribes.

  We recognize that these peoples are still here, and as settlers and kuyam
  (guests), we recognize our responsibility and obligation to care for their
  land in partnership with them. The City of Santa Monica commits to
  work in partnership with the Gabrieleño/Tongva people to uplift their
  voices and visibility on their ancestral land.

  LEVINE ACT  Pursuant to the Levine Act (Govt Code Section 84308), any party to a
  DISCLOSURE  permit, license, contract, or other entitlement before the Council is
  required to disclose on the record any contribution, including
  aggregated contributions, of more than $500 made by the party or the
  party's agents within the preceding 12 months to any City official.
  Participants and agents are requested to make this disclosure as well.
  The disclosure must include the name of the party, participant, or agent,

  1  July 29, 2025

  and any other person making the contribution; the name of the
  recipient, the amount of the contribution, and the date the contribution
  was made.

  No Councilmembers recused pursuant to the Levine Act.

  PUBLIC INPUT ON  Members of the public Juan Matute, Jerry Rubin, Denise Barton, Peter Trinh,
  REMAINING AGENDA  and Ericka Lesley commented on Item 16.A.
  ITEMS:

  COUNCILMEMBER  In accordance with Council Rule 6(y), all Councilmember Discussion items
  DISCUSSION ITEMS:  were considered and approved in one motion unless removed by a
  Councilmember for discussion.

  DOWNTOWN SANTA  16.A. Request by Councilmember Snell, with support from Mayor Pro
  MONICA INC  Tem Torosis and Councilmember Hall, requesting City Council
  consideration of the following: (1) Remove all six of the current City
  Council appointed board members to the DTSM Board of Directors;
  and (2) Make the necessary findings that there currently exists an
  emergency circumstance which requires the City Council to expedite the
  appointment process for six new board members to DTSM, was heard.

  Motion by Councilmember Snell, seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Torosis, to
  remove all six of the Council appointed members of the DTSM Board of
  Directors effective immediately. The motion was approved by the following
  vote:

  AYES:  Councilmembers Zwick, Hall, Raskin, Snell, Zernitskaya
  Mayor Pro Tem Torosis
  NOES:  Mayor Negrete
  ABSENT: None

  Motion by Councilmember Snell, seconded by Councilmember Hall, to
  suspend the Council rules, waiving the standard appointment process of
  ranked-choice voting and appointing the following interim members to the
  DTSM Board of Directors: Jonathan Gregory, Sean Besser, Hodge Patterson,
  Gleam Davis, Richard Bloom, and Elaine Polachek, and authorize the City
  Clerk to initiate the application process to appoint new members to the
  vacated terms at the September 9, 2025 City Council meeting. The motion
  was approved by the following vote:

  AYES:  Councilmembers Zernitskaya, Snell, Raskin, Hall, Zwick
  Mayor Pro Tem Torosis
  NOES:  Mayor Negrete
  ABSENT: None

  2  July 29, 2025
 Docusign Envelope ID: 8EF4C2EB-FF9F-4BE3-9494-9062E5A47610

  Mayor Negrete stated for the record that she voted no because she was
  uncomfortable with this process.

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council meeting adjourned at 6:58 p.m.

  ATTEST:  APPROVED:

  Nikima S. Newsome  Lana Negrete
  City Clerk  Mayor
